scenes.stage_direction: Phone contact becomes tangible. Let Amara listen before David interprets what the new evidence means.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: It is a real person. She wants a detail that was never in the messages.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Ask her about the blue cover. There is a repair at one corner.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Tell me exactly what she should look for.

metadata.evidence_summary: The contact is a real carer, not an invented identity.
